title: Pip's Island
about: Story data that any engine can read: quests, item pictures, end cards. Spoken words live in script.json, voices in cast.json.

1.title: Goodnight, Pip
1.text: You found the ducklings, picked berries, returned the shell, lit up the burrow and learned Fern's song. Everyone on the island is smiling!

2.title: Goodnight, Pip
2.text: Digby's tunnel, Pearl's tide pools and Captain Puff's new boat. Next time: sailing to Puffin Isle!

3.title: Goodnight, Pip
3.text: A boat trip to Puffin Isle, sand eels for Nana Puff's pufflings and hide and seek with Pebble. What an adventure!
